### 2026-10-17 – Decided to get started on the dimensions first, by referencing some existing designs from companies:

**3h**

### 2026-10-17 – The easiest way to neatly store tools would be slots in the bottom of the box, with a tray directly over it.

**2h**

The easiest way to neatly store tools would be slots in the bottom of the box, with a tray directly over it.

For the bottom of the box, I want ample space for utilities such as sanding tools. They have consistent, rectangular shapes, so having a slot to store different grits of sanding items would not be too ambitious to make.

Sketch of the slots:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/56a8b0bb68c9dfdcd0e608bf752c75cd742f31077362f1ad333e5b0f6b6a4bd0.png)

Additionally, I want to be able to carry cutting implements too, so another space was added to do that.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/0e159c765549354047def84c95a24383eb27155c125cb8bb7d471f17e2967283.png)

XActo knife slot added in sketch, as well as an open box for miscellaneous items such as spare blades.

Will arrange and model other sections in following entries.

### 2026-10-17 – After taking a break and looking at more tools, I realised the bottom right compartment of the tray is a little too small for a general-purpose compartment, so I adjusted the dimensions of the two mis

**2h**

After taking a break and looking at more tools, I realised the bottom right compartment of the tray is a little too small for a general-purpose compartment, so I adjusted the dimensions of the two miscellaneous items slots to make one more suited for additional tools.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/0601db3a8c46a6d76eb12445e66d66c7ea9d25627401a60a63937b516498203f.png)

I also widened and filleted the inner surface of the hobby knife slot, just for easier access.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/0b92336c11ed1dff030cb8e96630d74f0c9d216e917b5fad6a6a4dd77191c33a.png)

### 2026-10-18 – Started work on second tray:

**3h**

Started work on second tray:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 225200](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/c6f4774bc7dc484b1b282974f2ac91e239acfe89e0e390e215111ab373850488.png)
